+ +

body:
This is the tricky part with this setup. Invalid value default and MIssing Value default are states of the content attribute rather than being keyword handling. Empty value isn't even really a proper specially handled case atm (see #11451 ).

So I'm not sure how to update the attribute reflection algorithms to take the values from these new extended attributes into account.
This demonstrates the enum proposal I've only applied it here for now because I'm not as sure on this as the other stuff. But it should given an understanding of the idea.
